provenance.method: Decoded every .SerumPreset in the local library with fruitylink_serum.xfer and counted ModSlot source ids and destination (type, param) -> destModuleParamID pairs; parameter enums cross-checked against declaration strings in Serum2.vst3 (2.1.4). No amounts, curves or payloads are stored.

layout.section: ModSlot0..ModSlot63 (64 rows); an empty row is {'plainParams': 'default'} or absent
layout.destModuleTypeString: section family of the target (Oscillator, WTOsc, VoiceFilter, Env, LFO, Global, Macro, RoutingSlot, FX*)
layout.destModuleID: instance index within that family (Oscillator 0..4, VoiceFilter 0..1, Env 0..3, LFO 0..9, Global 0, FX unit index)
layout.destModuleParamName: the kParam* name of the target parameter
layout.destModuleParamID: index of that parameter in the module's parameter enum (see destinations)
layout.plainParams: kParamAmount -100..100 percent; optional kParamBipolar 1, kParamBypass 1, kParamCurveIn/Out, kParamOut
